items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And I had been out there playing at George's, that's why I first got my greetings from Uncle Sam, see.

ctx.x: 45, not then. Then Alfred Williams, they heard that I was back here, you see. And I had been out there playing at George's, that's why I first got my greetings from Uncle Sam, see. Oh yeah. And I was just to be allowed to come to Shreeport because I had some people living in Shreeport. See. And at the time I had a girl that I was very fond of at that time, see, in Shreeport. So they gave me permission to go to Fort Humburg in Shreeport to be inducted, see. And so I cut on back down there to Shreeport. And then,…
